results.title: Bandits promised to burn 250 cars in Zamfara, they have started since last week, they have burnt close to 50 so far, and they will continue
results.description:
Bandits promised to burn 250 cars in Zamfara, they have started since last week, they have burnt close to 50 so far, and they will continue until they reach their target. 
In this video, they chased out an entire village and set their vehicles ablaze. 

This is how it has become now, people’s lives and properties are meaningless, and the government is not acting, and the bandits will keep doing whatever they want. 

And the most annoying part.. they post all these videos themselves on their TikTok page, every time. 

If care is not taken, this insecurity will consume all of us.

results.title: In Gwashi, Zamfara, youths chased Deputy Governor Mani Malam Mummuni’s convoy with stones during a condolence visit after a bandit attack.
results.description:
In Gwashi, Zamfara, youths chased Deputy Governor Mani Malam Mummuni’s convoy with stones during a condolence visit after a bandit attack.
They chanted “Bamayi” we don’t want you.

When leaders fail to protect their people, the people will one day return the favor.
Serve them meaningfully today, or face their anger tomorrow.
